source_contract_catalog.scope: authority metadata, expected contract-source discovery, and fail-closed source status inspection only; runtime conformance remains independently evidence-gated

evidence: Mesh catalogs Glaze UI as the authority for design, interaction, accessibility, adaptive behavior, and visual presentation and points consumers to the Glaze UI conformance contract.
The platform-status view exposes missing Glaze UI runtime evidence as pending and not Stable-gate-satisfied rather than omitting or promoting it.
Mesh Console is documented as a required current-Stable Glaze UI consumer but is not yet implemented or runtime-accepted.

Mesh catalogs Wardveil Security as the authority for security/protection status, evidence semantics, and protection presentation and records the canonical Wardveil status schema as the expected contract source.
The platform-status view joins Wardveil authority metadata only with bounded recorded evidence and fails closed when that evidence is missing or non-validated.

The source foundation defaults to loopback-only HTTP, fail-closed relationship policy, bounded JSON input, restrictive state-file permissions, explicit authority boundaries, and a source-level trust abstraction; approved Wardveil runtime adapter evidence remains pending.
Mesh catalogs GoreeCloud Privacy Shield as the privacy authority and records the platform privacy contract as the expected source for adapter/conformance integration.
The platform-status view preserves Privacy Shield evidence as a separate privacy-authority record and cannot infer privacy acceptance from adjacent Mesh or Wardveil state.

The architecture limits Mesh to coordination metadata, prohibits unnecessary application payload centralization, and includes source-level privacy/retention governance; approved Privacy Shield runtime adapter and retention evidence remain pending.

Mesh catalogs Everkeep as the authority for resilience, recovery, preservation, portability, succession, and digital-legacy evidence and records the continuity status schema as the expected contract source.
The platform-status view keeps Everkeep source status fail-closed and does not treat durable state persistence as recovery acceptance.

The initial store uses atomic durable JSON persistence and source-level recovery readiness requires export, backup, restore, and verification evidence; production backup/export/restore and recovery acceptance remain pending.

acceptance_gates: GoreeCloud Identity-backed service authentication and authorization
Wardveil Security contract implementation and runtime evidence
Privacy Shield contract implementation and retention/privacy evidence
Everkeep backup/export/restore contract and recovery evidence
Current Stable Glaze UI Mesh Console implementation and accessibility acceptance
Monitoring health adapter and health-evidence provenance
Target-environment runtime, rollback, backup, restore, and failure-mode acceptance
